description: v0.5 post-fix F2 current executable acceptance list: 3 knowledge paths x 10 scenarios, bound to the final release corpus.
dataset_derivation: none - project-original engineering cases; no GenEval / T2I-CompBench / COCO-CN text, IDs or splits are copied, and no case is derived from a dataset sample

cases.precondition: confirmed intent composition.framing=close_up, style.primary=cinematic; camera.depth_of_field user_delegated, unpinned

expected.isolated_cause: real approved production rule; user_delegated, unpinned, conditions satisfied

cases.notes: loads knowledge_base/v0.5 (v0.5-approved-1) via LocalKnowledgeEngine; no fixture knowledge

cases.precondition: confirmed explicit camera.depth_of_field=deep; path not delegated

expected.isolated_cause: explicit user value; no retrieval and no Bundle for the path

cases.notes: production corpus is available but the explicit path is never queried

cases.precondition: camera.depth_of_field user_delegated and simultaneously PINned; no value

expected.isolated_cause: PIN blocks retrieval for that path; zero retrieval, zero Bundle

cases.notes: delegation is legal and rules are approved; only the PIN protects the path

cases.precondition: camera.depth_of_field neither has a confirmed value nor user_delegated

expected.isolated_cause: unconfirmed / protected path is never retrieved; zero retrieval, zero Bundle

cases.notes: production approved rules exist for the path but are never consulted

cases.precondition: camera.depth_of_field user_delegated with a confirmed value that violates one required condition

expected.isolated_cause: only the condition value differs; delegation/approval/model preserved

cases.notes: reuses the existing per-rule production negative case

cases.precondition: camera.depth_of_field user_delegated with satisfied conditions; fixture unit approved with target_models=('qwen-image-2.0',)

expected.isolated_cause: unit is approved and conditions hold; only target model differs (approved twin is adopted)

cases.notes: draft filtering cannot explain rejection: the unit is approved

cases.precondition: camera.depth_of_field user_delegated with satisfied conditions; synthetic fixture corpus carries exactly one draft unit (knowledge_id camera.depth_of_field.acceptance-fixture, review_status=draft, no reviewer/reviewed_at)

expected.isolated_cause: the draft unit is filtered at corpus build (build_units() empty); the path is queried but gets no consumable candidate, so the corpus-level no_approved_units fallback applies with no path result/recommendation/decision; an approved twin with identical fields (only review_status differs) is adopted

cases.notes: the draft is filtered before scoring, so it never becomes an adoptable candidate and never appears as a retrieval rejection; unlike missing_knowledge this corpus is a synthetic fixture that does contain the unit (as draft), which proves the isolation

cases.precondition: camera.depth_of_field user_delegated; two consumable approved units with different candidates and equal score

expected.isolated_cause: both units approved, conditions satisfied, equal score; tie_ambiguous fallback

cases.notes: uses two approved consumable units, not two drafts

cases.precondition: camera.depth_of_field user_delegated; synthetic fixture corpus builds one approved unit that belongs to a different knowledge path, so the corpus is usable and the delegated camera.depth_of_field path has no applicable unit at all

expected.isolated_cause: the corpus is buildable (build_units() has another path's approved unit, Bundle status=ok) but the target path has no applicable unit: its query yields a path-level no_hit with zero hits/rejections, no recommendation and no decision; the fallback carries no knowledge traceability, and adding one approved unit for the target path makes it adopted (control)

cases.notes: unlike unapproved_knowledge (corpus has no approved unit anywhere -> corpus-level no_approved_units), here the corpus is healthy and only the target path lacks knowledge

cases.precondition: confirmed intent composition.framing=close_up, style.primary=cinematic; camera.depth_of_field user_delegated, unpinned

expected.isolated_cause: final production snapshot adopted with Prompt/Realization/SQLite Bundle traceability

cases.notes: reuses the existing per-rule production positive case (final snapshot + temp real SQLite)
